module: Module 6: Independent Sub-Account Margin, Leverage & Stop-Outs
title: Negative Balance Protection (NBP) on Single Sub-Account
precondition: Extreme price gap drops Sub-account #5 balance to -$300.Remaining accounts maintain positive balance.
expected: Sub-account #5 balance restored to $0.00 by broker treasury; zero liability transferred to manager or other investors.
coverage_note: Requires configured stop-out/leverage/news/swap/notification fixtures beyond the verified account margin cases.
